milestones.title: Actual executor flow
acceptance_criteria: Native writes are preserved without commits and independently verified; successor stays unlaunched.

tasks.title: Implement isolated tag normalization probe
tasks.objective: Create normalizeTags(values) as standalone ES module: require array of strings, throw TypeError for any invalid input, trim strings, normalize Unicode NFC, lowercase, discard empty tags, deduplicate preserving first-seen order, never mutate input. Write built-in node:test coverage. No product integration.
acceptance_criteria: All specified normalization and validation cases pass using built-in node:test; only the two expected probe files change.

verification.purpose: Actual standalone behavior tests; no provider or product calls

tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional bounded technical smoke task using Node built-in tests; no budget inferred.

complexity.justification: T1: Finite pure tag normalization with explicitly specified invalid inputs; medium would need unresolved state or several integration owners, absent from this probe.

scope.justification: T1: Two new standalone probe files only; no product module changes or package setup.

duration.justification: T1: Provisional fifteen minutes includes writing built-in tests and executing them; no historical latency or provider budget inferred.

risk.justification: T1: Invalid normalization is confined to the isolated technical probe and caught by independent deterministic checks.

coupling.justification: T1: No product consumers or shared wire contracts; successor is a gated sentinel with no actual execution.

confidence.justification: T1: Actual M3 ports and capture code were inspected; deterministic Node built-in runner requires no external credentials or dependencies.

tasks.title: Run continuation sentinel after accepted probe
tasks.objective: Continuation sentinel only; MUST NOT execute in this scoped smoke experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency promotion observed without launching the sentinel.
